products.title: Nocturne Jamdani Pure Mulberry Silk Saree
products.fabric_type: 100-Count Fine Mulberry Silk & Tested Gold Zari
products.construction_method: Traditional Discontinuous Weft Handloom (180 Hours of Artisanal Weaving)
products.description: An ethereal heirloom saree woven by master artisans in Sonargaon. Features intricate floral jaal motifs and an opulent gold-dipped zari pallu, draped with featherweight fluidity.

craftsmanship_hotspots.title: Sonargaon Discontinuous Weft
craftsmanship_hotspots.detail: Every floral motif is individually inlaid by hand using fine bamboo spools, preserving a 400-year-old Bengal UNESCO heritage technique.

craftsmanship_hotspots.title: Pure Tested Gold Zari
craftsmanship_hotspots.detail: Metallic warp threads electroplated with micro-fine silver and gold alloys ensuring lifetime anti-tarnish luster.

craftsmanship_hotspots.title: 100-Count High-Twist Silk
craftsmanship_hotspots.detail: Mulberry silk cocoons hand-reeled for high tensile strength while retaining a whisper-soft cloud drape.

products.title: Rosewater Muslin Kalidar Anarkali Set
products.description: Voluminous 24-kali flared silhouette cut from pure breathable Dhaka muslin. Embellished with subtle antique gota patti and hand-embroidered resham flora. Includes matching churidar and scalloped dupatta.

products.title: Zari Embroidered Royale Velvet Shawl
products.description: Luxurious micro-velvet drape bordered with hand-stitched dabka, zardozi metal embroidery, and micro-pearl tassels. Ideal for wedding evenings and gala dinners.

products.title: Chanderi Silk Flared Kurti & Trousers Co-ord
products.description: Contemporary dual-toned co-ord set with asymmetric A-line kurti cut from lustrous Chanderi silk paired with tapered cigarette trousers.

products.title: Handcrafted Filigree Polki Choker Necklace
products.description: Exquisite Tantibazar fine wire filigree choker cast in hypoallergenic silver alloy with uncut simulated polki crystals and suspended Colombian emerald droplets.

products.title: Hand-Block Printed Organic Khadi Saree
products.description: Comilla hand-spun organic khadi cotton patterned with heritage wooden blocks using eco-friendly natural indigo and madder dyes. Effortlessly light and airy.

products.title: Organza Wrap Jacket & Trouser Fusion Ensemble
products.description: Tailored crossover wrap blazer crafted from crisp silk tissue organza with delicate threadwork borders, paired with straight-cut raw silk pants.

products.title: Scalloped Mukaish Work Pure Organza Dupatta
products.description: Featherweight sheer organza studded with hand-hammered silver mukaish stars and raw-edge scalloped resham embroidery.
